bug_and_bias_audit_findings: SURVIVORSHIP BIAS: the universe was built from the CURRENT Dhan scrip master, so it contains only securities listed today. 117 of 2707 NSE equities (4.3%). Mean name +264%, median +168%, worst survivor -87%. Every long-only backtest and every beta comparison in this project is biased upward.

reversal warmup bug: run_reversal applied start_date filtering BEFORE the warmup slice, so windowed walk-forward runs returned insufficient_data and any 'result' from them was void. Fixed by separating the indicator warmup index space from the reporting window.
the first wider-universe run reported 42.98% CAGR over a collapsed 5-month span; that was an artifact of the bug above plus midcaps with thin history, not a result.

look-ahead audit: injecting a 3x price shock into all future bars left the trade list and all pre-cut closed-trade P&L byte-identical. Decisions are look-ahead free. The differing headline return was mark-to-market on open positions only.

critical_finding_about_our_own_gate: the strategy passes the project gate (CAGR>6%, Sharpe>=0.5, DD>-15%) at 1.2% exposure, but it loses to beta at every risk-matched comparison. Sharpe is exposure invariant, so the strategy's 1.13 is below beta's 1.30 no matter the leverage. At matched drawdown of roughly -8%, beta would return about 7.9% at Sharpe 1.304 versus the strategy's 6.39% at Sharpe 1.117.
gate_correction: add a mandatory 'beats equal-weight beta on risk-adjusted return' criterion. A gate that passes a strategy which loses to the index is a defective gate, and that was ours.
